item.title: Draymond Green on Angel Reese
item.description:
Fullcourtpass: Draymond Green on why he confronted the fan

“I come down he’s like oh Draymond, you’re Angel Reese, ok that was a little funny. As the night goes on there’s more with it, hey Draymond you’re f*ckin Angel Reese”

Draymond Green on Angel Reese, Nov 17, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Angel Reese
item.description:
